note: Each preset is a real patient from the published training dataset, so its prediction is in-sample and optimistic. Presets demonstrate the interface; they are not a validation.

presets.label: No coronary disease
presets.description: Normal angiography and no regional wall-motion abnormality; highest EF.

presets.label: Single-vessel disease (LAD only)
presets.description: Only the LAD is significantly narrowed on angiography.

presets.label: Triple-vessel disease
presets.description: LAD, LCX and RCA are all significantly narrowed; youngest such patient.

presets.label: Extensive wall-motion abnormality, low EF
presets.description: Maximum regional wall-motion score with the lowest ejection fraction.

presets.label: Disease without chest pain
presets.description: Significant coronary disease in a patient reporting no chest pain.

presets.label: Typical chest pain, normal angiography
presets.description: Classic symptoms but open arteries; a case the model should not over-call.
